pr.title: Add diagnostic logging for PR-phase BRC history and draft cleanup
pr.description:
The PR-phase BRC history rewrite and draft cleanup functions have been
silently failing on every pipeline since #1602, leaving .egg-state/drafts/
in PR diffs and omitting .egg-state/brc-history/ files. The root cause
cannot be identified from production logs because all early-return paths
log at DEBUG level or not at all.

This adds INFO-level diagnostic logging to _write_brc_history,
_commit_statefiles_to_worktree, _rewrite_brc_history_for_pr, and
_cleanup_drafts_for_pr at every entry, exit, and decision point. It also
promotes the _cleanup_drafts_for_pr commit failure log from DEBUG to
WARNING, and adds an integration test that exercises the full call chain
in a real git repo to prevent future regression of the wiring.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: pytest orchestrator/tests/test_pr_phase_brc_rewrite.py — new integration test
- Automated: pytest orchestrator/tests/test_cleanup_drafts_for_pr.py — existing tests still pass
- Automated: make lint — no new lint violations
- Manual: Run one agent pipeline to PR phase and verify INFO-level logs appear for each function
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: None
Post-merge: Monitor the next agent pipeline PR to verify diagnostic logs appear and help identify the root cause of #1633
